## apiome graph {#graph}

The dependency graph: declare and list what an API depends on.

```text
apiome graph [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`declare`](#graph-declare), [`dependencies`](#graph-dependencies).

## apiome graph declare {#graph-declare}

Declare what an entity depends on (PUT …/entities/{kind}/{entity}/dependencies).

``--depends-on`` sends the **complete** list of the entity's manual declarations — it does not add to them — and ``--clear`` removes them. Declarations from the entity's spec and from Backstage files are not touched. A target that does not exist is not an error: it is listed as ``unresolved: not-found``.

```text
apiome graph declare [OPTIONS] KIND ENTITY
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KIND` | text | yes | Entity kind: project, catalog_item, mcp_endpoint, consumer, connector. |
| `ENTITY` | text | yes | The entity's id, or a project or catalog item's slug. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--depends-on` | text (repeatable) |  |  | `SLUG[#POINTER]` or `KIND:ID[#POINTER]` (repeatable). Replaces the entity's manual declarations: anything not listed is removed. |
| `--note` | text |  |  | A note attached to every --depends-on entry. |
| `--clear` | flag |  |  | Remove every manual declaration (cannot be combined with --depends-on). |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |

## apiome graph dependencies {#graph-dependencies}

List what an entity declares it depends on, from every source (GET …/dependencies).

```text
apiome graph dependencies [OPTIONS] KIND ENTITY
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `KIND` | text | yes | Entity kind: project, catalog_item, mcp_endpoint, consumer, connector. |
| `ENTITY` | text | yes | The entity's id, or a project or catalog item's slug. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | text | `table` |  | Output: table (default) or json (the API response). |
